audit_scope.description: This batch covers both EL and CL logic. EL topics include EIP-7702 EOA delegation, Prague block header validation, EIP-695 eth_chainId, MODEXP precompile, EIP-3198 BASEFEE opcode, and EIP-1052 EXTCODEHASH. CL topics include Capella fork transition, Gloas enshrined PBS with builder registry and PTC, and Deneb validator blob production/sidecar distribution. EIP-6963 covers browser-level wallet discovery which is outside the core protocol but relevant to user-facing security.

in_scope: State Transition (EOA delegation, block header validation)
Enshrined PBS (Gloas builder registry, PTC, bid lifecycle)
out_of_scope: Execution Layer internals when viewed from CL perspective

misclassified_entities.reason: System contracts (e.g., EIP-7685 request collectors) execute within the EL as part of block processing. They are protocol-defined internal components, not external entities. Their outputs are deterministic and derived from block execution state.

trusted_external_entities.name: User via JSON-RPC
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users submit transactions (including SET_CODE type 0x05) and query chain state via unauthenticated JSON-RPC. Any data from this channel is potentially malicious. Covers EXT-USER from EIP-7702/EIP-3198 and EXT-RPC-CLIENT from EIP-695.

trusted_external_entities.name: Smart Contract via EVM CALL
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: EVM CALL opcode to precompile addresses (0x05 MODEXP)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any contract can invoke precompiles with arbitrary input data. Input parsing and gas metering must handle all edge cases. Covers EXT-CONTRACT-CALLER from MODEXP.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peer Node via devp2p
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer nodes propagate blocks over unauthenticated P2P network. Blocks may contain invalid headers, malformed transactions, or crafted payloads. Covers EXT-P2P-PEER from Prague block header subgraph.

trusted_external_entities.name: Consensus Layer via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT but payload content (withdrawals, parent_beacon_block_root, requests) must be validated. The CL provides block data including withdrawals and execution payloads. Covers EXT-BEACON-CHAIN and EXT-BLOCK-PRODUCER interactions with EL.

trusted_external_entities.name: Execution Engine via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT. The EL provides execution payloads and blobs_bundle to proposing validators. Content must be validated (KZG commitments, blob integrity). Covers EXT-EXECUTION-ENGINE from Deneb validator subgraph.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peer Node via CL Gossip
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P Gossip Network (blob_sidecar subnets, block gossip)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers broadcast blob sidecars and blocks over unauthenticated gossip. All data requires full validation (KZG proofs, inclusion proofs, index bounds). Covers EXT-PEER and EXT-SYNC-PEER from Deneb validator subgraph.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Builder via PBS Bid Channel
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Builders submit execution payload bids that must be fully validated: BLS signature, builder active status, sufficient balance, matching slot/parent/randao, blob commitment limits. Covers EXT-BUILDER and EXT-BUILDER-OPERATOR from Gloas subgraphs.

trusted_external_entities.name: Wallet Browser Extension via DOM Events
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Browser extensions inject code into page context and announce wallet providers via DOM events. Any extension can impersonate legitimate wallets. Provider info (rdns, uuid, icon) cannot be trusted. Covers EXT-WALLET-EXTENSION, EXT-MALICIOUS-EXTENSION, and EXT-WALLET-APP from EIP-6963.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full transaction validation required: authorization list validation, chain ID check, nonce bounds, ECDSA signature recovery, existing code check, delegation target validation.
Request parsing and validation required. Response must reflect correct chain ID from head block configuration. No authentication required but rate limiting recommended.

Standard transaction validation. BASEFEE value is derived from block context (not user input) so the opcode itself is safe, but contracts using BASEFEE for pricing must handle manipulation by block producers.
Input parsing must handle: short input (zero-padding), zero-length fields, extremely large length values, modulus=0 edge case, gas cost must scale with operand complexity to prevent DoS.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Block header RLP decoding and validation pipeline
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full block header validation required: parent hash, state root, transactions root, receipts root, withdrawals root, requests hash (SHA2-256), blob gas fields. Malformed RLP must be rejected.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Engine API (withdrawal processing in block body)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Withdrawal data (index, validator_index, address, amount) comes from CL via authenticated Engine API. Content validation required: sequential indices, valid addresses, correct Gwei amounts. Withdrawals root must match header commitment.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Engine API (EIP-7685 requests hash in block header)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Requests hash in header must be recomputed from block execution results and verified against the SHA2-256 commitment. CL provides the header but EL independently validates.

Payload and blobs_bundle from EL must be validated: KZG commitments must match blob data, blob count within MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK, execution_payload must be consistent with PayloadAttributes sent.
Full sidecar validation required: blob index within bounds, KZG proof against commitment, Merkle inclusion proof linking commitment to block body, signed block header verification.
Serve only validated sidecars within retention window. Rate limit sync requests to prevent resource exhaustion.

Full bid validation: BLS signature verification, builder active status in registry (verified via finalized checkpoint), balance >= bid_value + MIN_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT + pending_withdrawals, matching slot/parent_block_hash/randao, blob commitment count within limits, parent block fullness check.
Payload envelope must match accepted bid: builder signature, payload consistency with bid commitments, blob data matching KZG commitments. PTC attestation determines builder payment.

No authentication possible for browser extensions. DApps must: freeze provider detail objects (Object.freeze), render SVG icons only via tag to prevent script execution, detect duplicate UUIDs as impersonation attempts, treat rdns as advisory only.
